items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I think this was before Dave Bontour was doing with the Peggy Lee thing

ctx.x: know what you have in the bank. He said, but don't tell the other guys. But it was a great band. We recorded, and we had -- we recorded with a singer, a girl by the name of Kay Penton. who was a beautiful singer. She was -- I think she was married to Slam too. We recorded 'What's New' -- we did quite a few recordings with Kay Penton. I don't know whether you've ever heard of her. Tremendous records. I don't think she's singing now.

But as I said, this was the first time -- I think this was before Dave Bontour was doing with the Peggy Lee thing, you know, with the guitar lead. We did it, you know. So -- but I think they might reissue this record --
